items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: He came in and asked me to join the band. ... I was promised -- Lionel guaranteed me $400 a week when I first joined the band.

ctx.x: Red Norvel, yeah. What else did you write for Lionel Hampton, besides Mingus Fingers?

Quite a few tunes with him. He said all that stuff was lost in the bus wreck. What was -- the names [BEBOPS -- see insert] I don't know. Some ballads. One was called (singing). I had this whole thing I wrote out. (Unintelligible) a little thing about bebop. And Lionel didn't want bebop. He said, "Hey, bobba rebop. It's rebop, not bebop." He says, "I made that up." Or he stole the tune.
